query: WITH ts_input AS ( SELECT websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AS query ) SELECT sv.work_id as "work_id!", sv.work_title as "work_title!", sv.primary_author_name as "primary_author_name!", ts_rank(sv.document, ts_input.query)::real as "rank!", ts_headline( 'english', sv.work_title, ts_input.query, 'StartSel=, StopSel=, MinWords=5, MaxWords=10' ) as "headline" FROM ts_input, book_search_view sv WHERE sv.document @@ ts_input.query ORDER BY ts_rank(sv.document, ts_input.query) DESC LIMIT $2
